narrative.overview: A precise utility laid on cool office paper, structured by ruled rows and explicit status rather than dashboard decoration.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies progress or interaction state, not generic decoration.

dos: Keep state and recovery actions visible in plain language.
Preserve a clear reading order at narrow widths.
donts: Turn the library into a grid of statistic cards.
Use the accent color as decoration.
